def transform(grid):
    # Each isolated horizontal colored bar is one item; pack items into 2x3.
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    items = []
    for row in grid:
        c = 0
        while c < len(row):
            if row[c] == background:
                c += 1
                continue
            color = row[c]
            items.append(color)
            while c < len(row) and row[c] == color:
                c += 1
    # The examples place the 3-bars before the 2-bars.
    items.sort(key=lambda color: (0 if color == 3 else 1 if color == 2 else 2, color))
    if len(items) > 6:
        raise ValueError('more than six bars')
    cells = items + [background] * (6 - len(items))
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
PY
